newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli assassin's birthday feted outside prison.
newsitem.headline: Israeli assassin's birthday feted outside prison.

text.p: A handful of Israeli ultra-nationalists held a birthday party on Thursday for the religious Jew who murdered Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin.
Four people brought champagne, flowers and a birthday cake to the Beersheba prison in southern Israel where assassin Yigal Amir is serving a life sentence.
"It is inconceivable that in our country of all places a Jew held in isolation and in terrible prison conditions must...celebrate his birthday alone," said Avigdor Askin.
Neither the four people nor the gifts were allowed in.
Amir, who recently turned 27, shot Rabin in the back in November 1995 to try to halt peacemaking with Arab partners.
The murder enraged Israelis across the political spectrum but some opposed to conciliation with the Arabs have expressed support for Amir.
Left-wing legislator Ran Cohen said he complained to police against the party. "I have asked police...to stop these scums," he told Israel Radio on Thursday.
